result:
I've made changes for all eight reports. TypeScript compiles cleanly, but I didn't run the test suite or try any of this in the running app.

**1. Personal inboxes.** In `src/server/services/notification-service.ts`, listing the inbox and changing notification settings now refuse anyone but the owner, whatever their role. Marking one alert read is limited to alerts delivered to the caller (`markRead` in `notification-repository.ts`).

**2. Mark all read.** `markAllRead` in `src/server/repositories/notification-repository.ts` now filters on the caller's own alerts. Before, it cleared every unread alert in the workspace.

**3. Links.**
- A new `src/server/services/_links.ts` builds links to pages the app actually serves, using the existing helpers in `src/lib/url.ts`.
- Issue alerts and search hits for issues and comments now link to the issue page in its workspace and project.
- Project hits link to the project page.
- The new-member alert links to the members settings page.
- Digest entries use the stored alert links, so they pick up the same fix.
- If the issue or project can't be found, the link falls back to the workspace's issues or projects page.

**4. New member alert.** It now goes to the workspace owner, and the person who joined is skipped.

**5. Status changes.** The assignee is told when someone else changes the status, including a board move (which goes through the same status change). Nothing is sent when there's no assignee or when the assignee made the change.

**6. Assignment at creation.** Creating an issue with an assignee now sends the same assignment alert, unless the assignee created it themselves.

**7. Full plan.**
- The new `reportPlanLimit` alerts the owner whoever tried. It's called where a project, seat, issue, upload or webhook endpoint is refused.
- It adds nothing while the owner's earlier alert for that resource is still unread, and a new one appears once it has been read.
- The usage recount never calls it.
- I treated "another issue in a project" as one resource across all projects. If you want a separate alert per project, say so.

**8. Switched-off alerts.** The inbox now lists only alerts delivered in-app. I didn't change the paging code itself, so I haven't confirmed the "no duplicates or gaps across pages" requirement beyond this filter.
